data.design: Repeat planks, windows and furniture; bookcases form a traversable route to the distant bed. Violet-grey with cold green traces. Dream associations are not biographical facts.

description: A larger false bedroom repeats familiar furnishings until bookcases become a winding route. Four readings support four riddles at a distant bed. A second empty bed is a decoy, not a new family biography.

links.description: 0.7.19 addition: second bedroom and transition to the Natu maze.

name: Your Room, Again
